title: The Ash Ravine
author: Gamebook Player sample
rights: Original sample text written for this repository. It is not a published gamebook, and this repository has no chosen license for it.

body: Grey ash drifts down into a narrow ravine. A rope bridge sways over the gap, a shallow ford runs below it, and a slope of loose scree climbs toward the far rim.
Halfway across, the planks creak and a cinder hound pads out of the ash on the far side, its eyes glowing like coals. It will not let you pass.
The water is cold and black. Something long and silver coils around your ankle: a ford eel, hungry and strong.
The eel drags you downstream and lets go at last. You crawl onto a sandbar, bruised and shivering.
The scree shifts under every step. One wrong foothold could send you tumbling all the way down.
You reach the far rim. Below, the ash settles on the ravine like snow.
